# Your Life, Your Lab (Ian's Blog)

> From chemistry to software engineering, and from engineering to product management — an ordinary person who keeps trying new things.

Author: Ian Tsai — https://ianlifelab.com/en/about/
Accept who you are and own your life.

I am IAN, a former software engineer who became a product manager because of my interest in products.
This blog is a place to record my learning experience in case I don&rsquo;t have enough brain capacity to remember what I&rsquo;ve learned, and also to share my life!

## The path so far

- Chemistry: Where it all started
- Software engineer: From chemistry into software
- Product manager: Switched careers out of a love for products
- Digital nomad: Chiang Mai, Busan, Hanoi, Kuala Lumpur
- Founder: MeFresh, FollowMate

## Things I've built

- [MeFresh](https://www.mefreshapp.com/): Booking and client management for beauty pros
- [FollowMate](https://www.followmate.cubelab3.com/): Turns what you agree on in LINE chats into to-dos
